alt: A chain of five consequences: leakage current forces a frequency wall, the wall forces multiple cores, multiple cores force GPUs, and GPUs force four-bit arithmetic.
caption: Each of these forced the next. The track follows the same order.

boxes.label: Leakage
boxes.sub: a switch costs energy to flip

boxes.label: The GPU
boxes.sub: many slow cores beat a few fast ones

boxes.label: Four-bit arithmetic
boxes.sub: because moving bytes is the cost
